architecture_summary: Modular React app. Pages in src/pages/. Shared components in src/components/. Tailwind CSS for styling. React Router v6 for navigation. No state manager (useContext + useReducer for global state).

tickets.title: Build DevOS table components reference page
tickets.description: Convert Stitch screen to React. Extract reusable table components (DataTable, SortableHeader, PaginationControls). Style match exact. Responsive.
acceptance_criteria: Page render pixel-perfect vs Stitch design
Tailwind classes match design system (orange theme)

tickets.title: Build DevOS engineering dashboard page
tickets.description: Convert Stitch dashboard to React. Extract reusable widgets (SummaryCard, ProgressBar, ActivityFeed). Style match exact. Data mocks for now.
acceptance_criteria: Page render pixel-perfect vs Stitch design

tickets.title: Create shared layout components
tickets.description: Build layout primitives (Header, Sidebar, MainContent). Extract common patterns from both screens. Style consistent with orange theme.

tickets.title: Implement design system tokens
tickets.description: Extract color, spacing, typography tokens from Stitch screens. Create Tailwind config + CSS variables. Apply globally.
acceptance_criteria: All colors match Stitch orange theme
Typography (font family, weights, sizes) match design

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Set up React Router. Create app shell with Header, Sidebar, MainContent. Route to both pages. 404 fallback.
acceptance_criteria: Navigation links work (no full page reload)
